i.content:
# Contributing

## Setup
Install Elixir and Erlang with asdf (versions are pinned in .tool-versions), then `docker compose up -d db`, `mix deps.get`, `mix ecto.setup`.

## Tests
`mix test`. Tests need the database container running.

## Pull requests
One change per PR, with a test, and a description that says why. Run `mix format` first.
